build_proteinnet_dataset: build a ProteinNet dataset using tfds.builder_cls('protein_net') for CASP7-CASP12 configurations
create_proteinnet_builder: create a ProteinNet dataset builder instance via lazy_builder_import.LazyBuilderImport('protein_net')
test_proteinnet_dataset: test the ProteinNet dataset builder with CASP12 threshold 90 configuration
